verdict.rationale: Pigment's own docs mention "scheduled imports," which implies recurring scheduled data-import jobs. That is a narrow, single-job-type form of scheduling, backed by only a brief marketing mention. The Analyst Agent's "continuous monitoring" is an adjacent behavior, not a user-configurable recurring schedule, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: general scheduling of recurring workflows or agent tasks, documentation of schedule configuration (frequency, cron or triggers), scheduling of non-import jobs such as calculations, exports or reports, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: easily integrated through native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports.
